title: Digital literacy
learning_outcomes: Explain files networks and data in the context of digital literacy.
Compare and distinguish digital tools in the context of digital literacy.
Apply access and privacy in the context of digital literacy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about reproducible workflow in the context of digital literacy.

lessons.title: Files networks and data
lessons.outcome: Explain files networks and data in the context of digital literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving files networks and data; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to workflow documentation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain files networks and data from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of files networks and data; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Digital tools
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish digital tools in the context of digital literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving digital tools; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to workflow documentation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain digital tools from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of digital tools; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Access and privacy
lessons.outcome: Apply access and privacy in the context of digital literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving access and privacy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to workflow documentation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain access and privacy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of access and privacy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reproducible workflow
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about reproducible workflow in the context of digital literacy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reproducible workflow; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to workflow documentation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reproducible workflow from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reproducible workflow; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of files networks and data; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of digital tools; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of access and privacy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reproducible workflow; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
